description.intro: The GloveGlu Mini Essentials Gift 5 x 50 ml spray kit brings together five essential products to clean, refresh and enhance the grip of goalkeeper gloves. Its compact format makes it possible to have different solutions for latex maintenance and adapt the adhesion to the playing conditions, forming a complete care system for training and matches.
key_benefits: Complete care: Bring together solutions to clean, refresh and improve glove grip in a single kit.
Grip for every situation: Includes different grip enhancers to use depending on the condition of the gloves and weather conditions.
Clean, fresh gloves: Cleaning and odor control products help keep equipment ready for the next use.
Formato compacto: Los envases de 50 ml facilitan el transporte de los productos para tenerlos disponibles en entrenamientos y partidos.
